title: Rav Nachman of Perhatya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Kiddushin 81a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.81a.5) he said to Rav Ashi, “The master, too, should administer lashes,” etc. Yuchasin reads ben Perata, while [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2687&lang=en) reads R' Nachman of Parpatya.[^1]

notes.text: Rav Nachman asks Rav Ashi to administer lashes and announce the reason, as Mar Zutra did. Hyman quotes only the opening. Heilprin’s headword is Rav Nachman ben Perata, while his citation gives Perpatya. Hyman attributes ben Perata to Yuchasin.
